items.title: 5 Google Photos updates to make the most of summer memories.
items.content: Five updates in Google Photos that will help you make the most of your summer memories.
items.contentSnippet: Five updates in Google Photos that will help you make the most of your summer memories.

summaries.zh: 谷歌相册推出五项更新，旨在帮助用户充分利用夏日回忆。这些更新包括改进的搜索功能、增强的自动分类能力、更智能的相册推荐、更便捷的共享选项以及优化的视频编辑工具。通过这些功能，用户可以更轻松地整理、发现和分享夏日照片与视频，提升整体使用体验。
summaries.en: Google Photos has rolled out five updates to enhance summer memory organization. These updates include improved search functionality, enhanced facial recognition, automatic album creation for events, advanced editing tools, and seamless integration with other Google services. The updates aim to make it easier for users to find, edit, and share their summer photos.

items.summary: 谷歌相册推出五项更新，旨在帮助用户充分利用夏日回忆。这些更新包括改进的搜索功能、增强的自动分类能力、更智能的相册推荐、更便捷的共享选项以及优化的视频编辑工具。通过这些功能，用户可以更轻松地整理、发现和分享夏日照片与视频，提升整体使用体验。

items.title: Behind Project Suncatcher, our moonshot to put AI in space
items.content: Learn about Project Suncatcher, how we’re testing hardware survival for space, designing cooling systems for AI chips, and more.
items.contentSnippet: Learn about Project Suncatcher, how we’re testing hardware survival for space, designing cooling systems for AI chips, and more.

summaries.zh: 项目“阳光捕手”旨在将人工智能送入太空。该项目重点测试硬件在太空中的生存能力，并设计用于AI芯片的冷却系统。通过这些技术验证，为AI在太空应用奠定基础。
summaries.en: Project Suncatcher is a space initiative focused on integrating AI into space environments. The project involves testing hardware durability in space, designing cooling systems for AI chips, and other related advancements. The goal is to ensure AI technology can function effectively in the harsh conditions of space.

items.summary: 项目“阳光捕手”旨在将人工智能送入太空。该项目重点测试硬件在太空中的生存能力，并设计用于AI芯片的冷却系统。通过这些技术验证，为AI在太空应用奠定基础。

items.title: Google and the Gates Foundation to bring AI resources to 200 million farmers across the Global South.
items.content: Smallholder farmers produce nearly 35% of the world’s food across more than 500 million farms, yet they often lack access to the satellite data, financial services, and …
items.contentSnippet: Smallholder farmers produce nearly 35% of the world’s food across more than 500 million farms, yet they often lack access to the satellite data, financial services, and …

summaries.zh: 谷歌与盖茨基金会将向全球南方20亿农民提供AI资源。小型农户占全球粮食产量的35%，但常缺乏卫星数据、金融服务等支持。此次合作旨在通过AI技术帮助农民提高生产效率，改善农业发展。
summaries.en: Google and the Gates Foundation will provide AI resources to 200 million farmers in the Global South. Smallholder farmers, who produce nearly 35% of the world's food across over 500 million farms, often lack access to satellite data, financial services, and other essential tools. This initiative aims to bridge these gaps by leveraging AI to improve agricultural efficiency and support farming communities.

items.summary: 谷歌与盖茨基金会将向全球南方20亿农民提供AI资源。小型农户占全球粮食产量的35%，但常缺乏卫星数据、金融服务等支持。此次合作旨在通过AI技术帮助农民提高生产效率，改善农业发展。

items.title: Investing in global talent and AI literacy
items.content: Google is providing 100,000 scholarships to the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) through the AI Skills Coalition.
items.contentSnippet: Google is providing 100,000 scholarships to the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) through the AI Skills Coalition.

summaries.zh: 谷歌通过人工智能技能联盟向国际电信联盟（ITU）提供10万奖学金，以培养全球人才并提升人工智能素养。
summaries.en: Google is donating 100,000 scholarships to the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) via the AI Skills Coalition. The initiative aims to invest in global talent and enhance AI literacy. The scholarships will help individuals develop skills in artificial intelligence, supporting workforce development and innovation worldwide. The program underscores Google's commitment to expanding access to AI education and training.

items.summary: 谷歌通过人工智能技能联盟向国际电信联盟（ITU）提供10万奖学金，以培养全球人才并提升人工智能素养。
